segments.sn55.40:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.sn55.40:1.2: Atha kho nandiyo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nandiyo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn55.40:1.3: “yasseva nu kho, bhante, ariyasāvakassa cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi sveva nu kho, bhante, ariyasāvako pamādavihārī”ti.
segments.sn55.40:2.1: “‘Yassa kho, nandiya, cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi tamahaṃ bāhiro puthujjanapakkhe ṭhito’ti vadāmi.
segments.sn55.40:2.2: Api ca, nandiya, yathā ariyasāvako pamādavihārī ceva hoti, appamādavihārī ca taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi;
segments.sn55.40:2.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho nandiyo sakko bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.sn55.40:3.2: Idha nandiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.40:3.4: So tena buddhe aveccappasādena santuṭṭho na uttari vāyamati divā pavivekāya, rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
segments.sn55.40:3.5: Tassa evaṃ pamattassa viharato pāmojjaṃ na hoti.
segments.sn55.40:3.11: Dhammānaṃ apātubhāvā pamādavihārī tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn55.40:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, nandiya, ariyasāvako dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.40:4.4: So tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi santuṭṭho na uttari vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
segments.sn55.40:4.5: Tassa evaṃ pamattassa viharato pāmojjaṃ na hoti.
segments.sn55.40:4.11: Dhammānaṃ apātubhāvā pamādavihārī tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn55.40:4.12: Evaṃ kho, nandiya, ariyasāvako pamādavihārī hoti.
segments.sn55.40:5.2: Idha, nandiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.40:5.4: So tena buddhe aveccappasādena asantuṭṭho uttari vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
segments.sn55.40:5.5: Tassa evaṃ appamattassa viharato pāmojjaṃ jāyati.
segments.sn55.40:5.11: Dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā appamādavihārī tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn55.40:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, nandiya, ariyasāvako dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.40:6.4: So tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi asantuṭṭho uttari vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
segments.sn55.40:6.5: Tassa evaṃ appamattassa viharato pāmojjaṃ jāyati.
segments.sn55.40:6.11: Dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā appamādavihārī tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn55.40:6.12: Evaṃ kho, nandiya, ariyasāvako appamādavihārī hotī”ti.
segments.sn55.40:7.1: Abhisandā tayo vuttā, duve devapadāni ca;
segments.sn55.40:7.3: Sabhāgataṃ mahānāmo, vassaṃ kāḷī ca nandiyāti.

lines: Dasame divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāyāti divā pavivekatthāya rattiṃ paṭisallānatthāya.
Dhammā na pātubhavantīti samathavipassanā dhammā na uppajjanti.
